adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` (routes.rb) and an Ember controller action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb) ignores `params` and simply re-serializes `@embedding` (which is always rebuilt from `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)` in `fetch_embedding`). That makes the PUT endpoint effectively a no-op that returns 200. However, in the added UI template (admin/templates/embedding.hbs) nothing invokes `saveChanges`; host persistence is handled via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` and `host.save/destroyRecord`. So this is a real, diff-grounded incompleteness/misleading endpoint rather than a currently-triggered defect in the shown flow.
